SELECT sum(l.l_extendedprice) / 7.0 AS avg_yearly
FROM lineitem AS l
JOIN (
    SELECT li.l_partkey, 0.2 * avg(li.l_quantity) AS quantity_threshold
    FROM lineitem AS li
    JOIN part AS p ON p.p_partkey = li.l_partkey
    WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#23'
      AND p.p_container = 'WRAP BAG'
    GROUP BY li.l_partkey
) AS thresholds ON thresholds.l_partkey = l.l_partkey
WHERE l.l_quantity < thresholds.quantity_threshold
LIMIT 1;

SELECT sum(l.l_extendedprice) / 7.0 AS avg_yearly
FROM part AS p
JOIN (
    SELECT l_partkey, 0.2 * avg(l_quantity) AS quantity_threshold
    FROM lineitem
    GROUP BY l_partkey
) AS a ON a.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN lineitem AS l ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#25'
  AND p.p_container = 'WRAP PACK'
  AND l.l_quantity < a.quantity_threshold
LIMIT 1;
